# Utah Backyard ADUs

> Utah-based ADU (accessory dwelling unit) builder. Founder-led, 50+ ADUs of experience. Custom stickbuilt construction, factory-built modular units, and garage-to-ADU conversions across the Wasatch Front and greater Utah.

Utah Backyard ADUs designs, permits, and builds backyard accessory dwelling units for Utah homeowners who want rental income, multigenerational housing, or extra living space. Every estimate starts with a free, no-obligation property visit. Licensed & insured Utah general contractor, License #14296577-5501.

## Services & typical pricing
- Garage conversion: $50,000-$120,000
- Modular / prefab ADU: $120,000-$200,000
- Custom stickbuilt ADU: $120,000-$300,000

## Service area
Salt Lake County (including Salt Lake City), Utah County (including Provo), Ogden, Park City, and surrounding Utah communities.

## Utah ADU law summary (as of November 2026)
- Internal ADUs (within the home's footprint) are a permitted use in Utah residential zones (Utah Code 10-21-303, originally HB82, 2021). Cities may prohibit them on lots of 6,000 sq ft or less, require one extra parking space, prohibit rentals under 30 days, and prohibit renting one in a home that is not the owner's primary residence.
- Detached ADUs: as of Oct. 1, 2026, SB284 (Utah Code 10-21-304) requires most larger Utah cities to allow a detached ADU as a permitted use on single-family lots of 11,000 sq ft or more. Cities cannot require a conditional use permit in residential zones or more than 2 parking spaces (units 650+ sq ft) / 1 space (smaller). Cities may regulate size, height, setbacks, lot coverage, owner occupancy, one ADU per lot, and rentals under 90 days.
- HOAs may still prohibit detached ADUs but generally cannot ban internal ADUs.
- Full guide: https://utahbackyardadus.com/blog-utah-detached-adu-law-sb284-2026.html
